purpose: Chapter 5 turn-event slot 3 handler (dispatch idx 0x11, fired turn 8 / phase 0): arms the per-event AI/dialog control flag to 7 for 4 chars, then plays a two-page dialog beat around cutscene event 0x18.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no-branch, no-RNG. (1) fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x30,0x33,7) sets the low nibble of combat_aux_block[0xD] to 7 for chars 0x30..0x33. (2) fd2_display_dialog_scene(text,page=6,...) shows dialog page 6. (3) fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x18) plays cutscene event 0x18. (4) fd2_display_dialog_scene(text,page=7,...) shows dialog page 7. In the original binary the page-7 call is reached by JMP 0x343FA into the shared tail of fd2_chapter_event_handler_04 (PUSH page=7..PUSH text; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene; ADD ESP,0x24; RET); src reproduces it as an inline call for Layer-2 equivalence.
